title: Dino Worlds M4 art
read_only_source: /workspace/dino-worlds branch m3; Assets/Scripts/Sim.cs and Meta.cs names
coordinate_system: Unity Y-up, +Z-facing; model pivots at (0,0,0) on ground; terrain extends below top at Y=0

import_defaults.models: FBX scale 1, convert file units enabled, import normals, tangents Calculate Mikktspace or none for no normal maps, mesh compression Off initially, Read/Write Off, no auto colliders, animation None, material remap DW_ToyVinyl
import_defaults.material: URP Lit or built-in Standard, shared atlas base map, base color white, metallic0 smoothness0.58; no normal map needed
import_defaults.textures: DW_ToyAtlas.png: 512, sRGB, mipmaps On, Clamp, Bilinear, anisotropy1; desktop/WebGL compression optional. Atlas swatches have generous gutters.
import_defaults.ui: Sprite metadata included after Unity validation; nine-slice values use L,B,R,T pixels. Empty skins intentionally require runtime text. Metadata uses FullRect sprite meshes; the icon atlas has 23 named sprite rects.

caveats: Static unrigged meshes; no skeletal animation or clips.
Decorative island and shore meshes do not encode navmesh, collider or valid deployment cells. Use existing Sim data unchanged.
All meshes are original toy interpretations, not scientific reconstructions.
UI counters/text are runtime-rendered; skin images are text-free for scaling/localization.
Same geometry shared across island recolors; do not randomize gameplay layout.

materials.mapping: Shared across every mesh; exact Kind, DefKind, BldKind and Isles index mappings are on the model entries
materials.shader: Standard (built-in); convert/remap to URP Lit if target uses URP

delivery_notes: Copy .meta files together with each asset: material GUID/remap, exact sprite rectangles and slice borders are already authored. Do not copy the throwaway project or source scripts into game Assets.

supporting_files.role: Exact mapping, file list and integration notes
Single visual preview of all models and UI sprites/states
Machine-readable mappings, geometry and import information
